units.source_text: 瞬间，火柴的火苗闪烁着小小的透明的亮光。

en.t: For an instant, the flame of the match flickered with a small, transparent light.

units.source_text: 我觉得学生的眼里甚至看不见火的颜色，

en.t: It seemed to me that the student could not even see the color of the fire in his eyes,

units.source_text: 因为这时午后的阳光正好包围着山门的三方，只在我所在的一边投下了影子。

en.t: because at that moment the afternoon sunlight was surrounding three sides of the gate, casting shadow only on the side where I stood.

units.source_text: 短暂的瞬间，火苗于传在荷花池畔的山门柱旁的学生的脸庞近处，浮现出类似火的虚幻议的东西。

en.t: For that brief instant, near the face of the student by the pillar of the gate beside the lotus pond, the flame brought forth something illusory that resembled fire.

units.source_text: 接着，在他的猛然挥动的手上熄灭了。

en.t: Then it went out against the hand he suddenly waved.
